login.headline: Every fibre begins with a cocoon.
login.story: For five hundred years, silk carried its origin with it as it changed hands in Bursa. KozaPass follows the same trail through today's supply chain: it brings each batch's spinner, weaver, dyehouse and certificates together in a single passport.
login.storyShort: Every step of your supply chain, in a single passport.
login.illustrationLabel: A thread leaving a cocoon and passing through the yarn, fabric, dyeing and garment steps.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Continue with your company account.
login.serverError: The server can't be reached right now. Please try again in a few seconds.
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Contact your company administrator.

tasks.title: Tasks
tasks.sub: Supply chain steps and documents waiting for your approval.
tasks.emptyTitle: No tasks waiting for your approval
tasks.emptyBody: Steps sent by suppliers and documents read by AI are collected here. Fields with confidence below 0.80 are listed first.

products.title: Products
products.sub: Product cards and fibre compositions by GTIN.
products.emptyBody: A passport always belongs to a product. Define your first product with its GTIN, name and fibre composition.

batches.title: Batches
batches.sub: A digital product passport is published for every production batch.
batches.emptyBody: Create your first batch: choose the product, assign the workshops in the supply chain and collect the documents. An approved batch is published as a passport with a QR code.

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.sub: Spinners, weavers, dyehouses and contract workshops.
suppliers.emptyBody: Add or invite your suppliers; they can upload their documents through the link you send them.

documents.title: Documents
documents.sub: Certificates, delivery notes and technical sheets. AI reads, you approve.
documents.emptyBody: Upload PDF, JPG or PNG files (up to 10 MB each). AI extracts the certificate number, validity date and fibre percentages and submits them for your approval.

imports.title: Imports
imports.emptyBody: Upload your product and batch lists as Excel. Download the template and fill it in.

users.title: Users
users.emptyBody: Invite your office team. Only Company owners and Administrators can approve and publish.

settings.title: Settings
settings.emptyBody: Complete the company name, address and logo that appear on the passport.
